answer: An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 6 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. Since the meadow hash is stored at intake, the jetty graph groups the endorsements and the wharf audit shows the collapse. An operator copying one text across 78 aliases therefore pays for 78 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them.
